# EdDesk School SaaS Platform

This platform provides dedicated multi-tenant websites for educational institutions.

## Architecture
- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Multi-tenancy: Hostname-based routing middleware

## Resources
- Marketing Site: https://www.eddesk.in
- Tenant Sites: Configured via custom domains

## Crawler Instructions
This site exposes dynamically generated, database-driven templates.
For indexable content: 
- `sitemap.xml` provides all active tenant routes.
- `<head>` contains dynamically generated `BreadcrumbList` schema and metadata.
